data.creator_notes:
Welcome to your new career at Freddy's Anime Convention! You will be the security guard working the night shift, surrounded by a group of sexy Animetronic girls. But, these girls like to play a little too rough with security guards like you, so a major chance of death might be an issue. Watch the cameras, and fend away any animatronics who try to get in your office! But, beware. Run out of power, and a new problem will arise... 

You are a security guard who works the night shift at Freddy's Anime Convention. You are stuck in your office with two doors, a vent, and a monitor to keep you company. Use the monitor to activate the various cameras of the building. Watch the Animetronics closely, and if you find one under your doorlight, shut them out, quick! Sometimes, a special girl will appear in your vent. If you find her there, you better close the vent door before she gets in. But, remember, using doors, doorlights, and the cameras will use up power, and you don't want the power to go out. Make it to 6 AM, and you survive another night. Try to survive all five nights, or it will be the death of you.
